chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When a man leaves his home for travel, he is not permitted to divorce [his wife] until three months have passed."
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a man to divorce his wife while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes a specific legal restriction preventing a man from divorcing his wife while traveling, requiring a three-month period of residence after departure. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling highlights the importance of stability and deliberation in marital decisions, contrasting with the general permissibility of *talaq* during travel, and serves to prevent impulsive divorces during the uncertainty of a journey.
